doc.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

title: Class clowns: Ray Nance and Freddie Jenkins
summary: Tate names Ray Nance and Freddie Jenkins as the funniest in Duke's band.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Tell us one of the, if you can share with us, who do you think was, if you were assigning personalities to the band, who would have been the class clown of the band?
Like that did the funny things?

I would say Ray Nance in the later years with Duke, then before Ray Nance was a guy named Freddie Jenkins. He was with Duke. And they would do funny things you know, in the band. Those would be my two greatest ones I think. We had Ray and Freddie. Ray Nance’d be laughing all night.
